title: Read the Status Code
story: Every response starts with a number. 2xx means fine, 4xx means you did something wrong, 5xx means the server did.
goal: Request /missing and report its status code.
hints: curl can print only the status with -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}", or show headers with -I.
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
